newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: C.G. Smith sees real '96/97 shr growth.
newsitem.headline: C.G. Smith sees real '96/97 shr growth.

text.p: South African industrial holding company, C.G. Smith Ltd said on Wednesday it was confident of achieving meaningful real earnings growth in the 1996/97 financial year.

It said a drive to ensure that group companies were globally competitive would continue in an environment where the country's Gross Domestic Product was expected to be at much the same level as in 1996.
"In the light of this (drive) the group is confident of achieving meaningful real growth in earnings in the year ahead," it said in a statement accompanying its year end results.
